# Grade Submission

## Summary
Turns rubric picks into a Grade (late %, override, letter snapshot) and marks the submission graded, or returns it for revision.

## Refuses when
not submitted; no rubric; unknown criterion/level; unscored criterion.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.
